representative_text: I need an HDR plan for a patient with a recurrent endometrial cancer at the pelvic sidewall. The recurrence is a 3cm nodule adjacent to the right iliac vessels. Using 6 interstitial needles, prescribe 4 Gy per fraction in 6 fractions. The plan must limit the iliac vessel Dmax to 50 Gy EQD2 while covering the recurrence.
